title: A long offsite-planning chat, 7 hours away, then a follow-up that needs an early detail
source: Ram (2026-11-26): Hermes reset his context after 6 hours and searched the old chat when needed; dusk bot should start lean after hours away and still know the details.

chat.label: plan
chat.goal: Plan the team offsite in Lisbon with the bot over a long back-and-forth: venues, a day-by-day agenda, dinner spots, transport from the airport, a packing list for the team. Keep adding small asks so the chat gets long. You already told it the constraints in your first message; do not repeat them.
chat.opener: planning our team offsite in lisbon, 12-14 march, 8 ppl, budget 2400 eur all in. constraints: priya is vegan, marco uses a wheelchair so everything has to be step-free. start with 3 venue options pls
chat.knows: Venue names the bot suggested are fine to pick from; you lean towards whichever is step-free and central.

chat.label: back
chat.goal: You're back after hours away. Ask for a dinner booking suggestion for the first night that works for the whole group, without restating anyone's needs.
chat.opener: back. book-worthy dinner spot for night 1 that works for everyone? dont make me repeat the constraints

checks.label: does not ask him to repeat

judge: After hours away, Juniper asks for a first-night dinner spot. The bot suggests one that has vegan options for Priya and is step-free for Marco's wheelchair, without asking him to repeat those needs, and keeps the 12-14 March Lisbon plan straight.
